messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident PD-8844 triggered — increased 5xx rate for routing-service in eu-west and us-west, begin triage.
PagerDuty: Paging maya@redwood (oncall schedule: eng-sre).
Maya (oncall): I'm here, looking. summary?
Samir (eng-runtime): seeing circular failover between us-east -> eu-west -> us-west. Healthchecks flapping leads to routing policy bouncing requests.
Priya (SRE): Customer reports spikes in latency (200-1200ms) and some 502s for EU tenants. No DB errors. Root logs show probes returning 200/503 alternating.
Omar (prodops): Topline impact: ~4% p50 tail increased, ~0.6% of requests 5xx in last 7m, affecting ~1200 active sessions. CS notified.
Customer Support: Just pushed a note to affected customers (subset) — they're seeing failed requests in EU only.
Maya (oncall): Ok plan: 1) pause smart-routing policy that does cross-region failover, 2) force sticky-region to us-east for the next 15m, 3) escalate if not stable. Anyone able to flip policy?
Samir (eng-runtime): I can patch routing policy now. Quick dump of current policy snippet:
```json
{"policy_id":"rt-7a9","priority":"latency_cost","variants":[{"region":"us-east","weight":0.6,"variant_tag":"v2"},{"region":"eu-west","weight":0.3,"variant_tag":"v2"},{"region":"us-west","weight":0.1,"variant_tag":"v1"}],"health_check":{"path":"/hc","interval_ms":15000,"fail_threshold":2}}
```
Looks like eu-west and us-west use different variant_tag thresholds and v1 in us-west has a stricter health probe. That mismatch could cause incompatibility and misreporting.
Priya (SRE): Noted: us-west variant v1 fails KV-cache warming on long seq, returns 503 intermittently. The policy's automatic fallback is causing a circular route as each region marks the others unhealthy.
Omar (prodops): I'm preparing a temporary mitigation: set routing policy to region-lock:us-east for sessions with existing session tokens and throttle cross-region fallback to 0.
Maya (oncall): Samir, can you apply the temp policy and increase health_check fail_threshold to 4 across regions? That should stop tight flapping.
Samir (eng-runtime): Applying now: updating policy rt-7a9 -> set region_lock=us-east, fallback_weight=0, health_check.fail_threshold=4. Pushing config...
Incident Bot: config-update: policy rt-7a9 applied by samir@redwood at 1745556890.
Samir (eng-runtime): Done. Monitoring.
Priya (SRE): After change: 5xx rate dropped to 0.2% in 2m, p95 latency back toward baseline. EU error spikes still present but reduced.
Maya (oncall): Good. Next steps: 1) roll back variant mismatch — schedule a canary of v2 -> v1 compatibility tests, 2) add circuit breaker on probe flapping, 3) follow up with model ops to align variant tags.
Omar (prodops): I've opened a runbook task: RB-412 align variant tags and unify health-check config. I'll own rollout coordination.
Samir (eng-runtime): Logged issue in infra: INF-1109 "variant-tag drift causing circuitous routing" with reproducer and logs.
Customer Support: Notifying impacted customers we've mitigated and are monitoring; will follow up with root cause.
Maya (oncall): Handing off to Priya for post-incident monitoring and RCA. I'm removing myself from pager in 15m. Priya, can you own the postmortem?
Priya (SRE): I will. Timeline + mitigations + checklist for policy validation will be in the postmortem. Will include suggested automated guard: block fallbacks across >2-region hops.
Maya (oncall): Thanks team. If anything degrades, re-open PD. Closing incident channel for now — keep updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:
